message: No detected input validation: The code loads JSON and pickle files and calls missing_values1 for null-filling, but there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards validating the structure or content of the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local files (DATA/train.json, DATA/test.json, pickle files) with no remote fetching, and no checksums or integrity verification are performed on any of the files.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pickle files (author_citation_dic, author_db) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision, and no pretrained model weights are loaded with integrity controls.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous label distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a validation split is performed via split_val, there is no isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code only handles missing values via missing_values1/2 (filling nulls with defaults/means) but performs no shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or rejection of malformed inputs before inference.

No detected output bounds checks: There is no code visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, probability sanity bounds, or any other post-prediction validation before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a citation-count regression pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection is not applicable and no such defenses are implemented.
